data.description:
Valerie wants to see the rendering system in action: one HTML page showcasing every dialect family, the variation injectors, the form generators and generated samples.

Build a /gallery page in lofsite, generated from real code output, never mockups. Content:
1. Per dialect family: the archetype rendering of one or two exemplar forms (text dialects as formatted text, visual dialects as the actual SVG or PNG), then the same form under 2 or 3 variation seeds or injector settings, side by side, so the archetype-versus-variation idea is visible.
2. The generator: sampled forms from each of the 5 difficulty tiers with their depth and step counts.
3. Suite v1: headline numbers (120 forms, 29 dialects, 3,480 cells) and a sampled row of cells.
4. A static export mode so the same page can be saved as one self-contained HTML file and shared.

Design follows Tufte: the gallery is small multiples; direct labels on every panel; no decorative ink; monospace for form strings; a single accent colour for the one thing each section wants the eye on. Sentence-case headings, GOV.UK prose.

The page must render every registered dialect by iterating the registry, so future dialects appear without editing the gallery.
data.title: Rendering showcase gallery: every dialect, variation and generator, live

data.body:
Implemented on feat/DB-12-gallery (commit 23a0c3b). New: src/lofsite/gallery_data.py (pure data), src/lofsite/pages/gallery.py (FastHTML), src/lofsite/export_gallery.py (static CLI), tests/test_lofsite_gallery.py (18 tests). Modified: app.py (+/gallery route), layout.py (+nav entry, +public style_css() accessor).

Verified: uv run pytest -q -> 7459 passed, 3 skipped. ruff clean on touched files. Booted server, curl /gallery -> 200, all 34 list_renderers()-minus-composed dialect ids present in HTML (circle via alias caption, not a duplicate panel). Ran export CLI -> dist/gallery.html, self-contained (0 external script/link/img src=http, 18 inline PNG data URIs), byte-identical across two independent build_static_document() calls, write/read-back byte-identical. Server killed after verification.

16 archetype groups across 13 families (biopolymer/parens/trees have 2 archetypes each, matching the plan); 7 have real injector variations (all content-distinct, tested), 9 use the honest deeper-exemplar fallback (spatial archetypes + enclosure, no injector implemented yet). pattern family has 5 injector-bearing siblings; only 3 (java/lisp/python) get panels per the plan's cap -- rust/scheme are named in the group's omitted_ids (new field, not in the original plan) and counted by the accounting test, so acceptance criterion 1 (every registered dialect accounted for) still holds via caption/attribution rather than a panel.

Deviations from plan, both driven by getting acceptance criterion 1 to actually pass rather than just eyeballing it:
1. Added ArchetypeGroup.omitted_ids (see above) -- the plan's "pick first 3 by sorted id" for pattern's 5 siblings silently drops 2 dialect ids, which conflicts with "every registered dialect accounted for". Resolved by naming the omitted ones in the group's note/omitted_ids rather than crashing or overclaiming panel coverage.
2. canonical's default construction (CanonicalConfig(spacing=False)) never touches rng -- contrary to the plan's claim that canonical "does take an rng and varies internally". Its seed-pair demo constructs explicitly with spacing=True (captioned as such) so the demo shows real variation instead of two byte-identical seeds.
3. Found and fixed a real determinism bug during export verification: noisy_parens's legacy *primary* panel (rendered without an rng arg) fell back to an unseeded random.Random(), so build_static_document() was not actually pure across calls despite its docstring claiming so. Fixed with a dedicated LEGACY_DEFAULT_SEED for every legacy primary panel; added a regression test (test_legacy_primary_panels_are_deterministic_across_builds) and reverified byte-identical output across two independent builds.

Static export also copied to the orchestrator's scratchpad path for handoff (gallery-showcase.html).

REVIEW (agent:claire-reviewer-db12, cold read of commit 23a0c3b on feat/DB-12-gallery). VERDICT: PASS.

Gates: uv run pytest -q -> 7459 passed, 3 skipped (matches claim). uvx ruff check clean on all 6 touched files (note: ruff is not in the .venv; use uvx/pre-commit, not 'uv run ruff'). Gallery test file: 18 passed.

Registry completeness (the AC with teeth): verified programmatically, not by eye. accounted_dialect_ids(data) == set(list_renderers())-{composed} exactly: 34==34, zero missing, zero extra. Fetched live /gallery from the running server on :5001 -> HTTP 200, 386KB; all 34 registry ids literally present in the HTML, circle present via alias caption (no duplicate panel). The monkeypatch test genuinely proves the zero-edit property: it injects fake.extra-v1 into list_renderers/DIALECT_SPECS and faked get_renderer, and the new dialect surfaces in accounting and as a new family group with no gallery-module edit.

Variation honesty: 7 real-injector groups (biopolymer.rna_dotbracket, embedding, parens@1, parens.word_brackets, pattern, prose, trees.tree_indent) -- canonical+variation panel contents all byte-distinct (confirmed by diffing .content, not just no-raise). 9 fallback groups (8 spatial archetypes + enclosure) each carry exactly one deeper-exemplar panel with an honest 'no injector variation registered ... showing a deeper input instead' caption, canonical.content != fallback.content (real deeper form, not a fake reseed). canonical seed-pair demo is captioned 'spacing=True passed explicitly ...' as disclosed. noisy_parens/canonical seed pairs render distinct content; nested_list/sexpr correctly carry no seed pair.

Determinism bug fix: LEGACY_DEFAULT_SEED=0 seeds every legacy primary panel; without it noisy_parens' default render(rng=None) fell back to unseeded random.Random(). Regression test (test_legacy_primary_panels_are_deterministic_across_builds) present. Confirmed build_static_document() twice -> byte-identical.

Static export: ran uv run python -m lofsite.export_gallery --out <tmp> -> 383KB, starts with <!doctype html>, head/title/inline <style>, 18 inline PNG data URIs, ZERO external script/link/img src=http, zero http(s) src/href of any kind -> fully self-contained, opens standalone. build_static_document() is pure (byte-identical across calls; write/read-back byte-identical test present).

Generator: exactly 5 tier samples, all depth>=0 & steps>=0. Suite v1: headline 120/29/3480 read live from load_suite() (n_forms/specs/cells match exactly), 12-cell deterministic sample.

Design/Tufte: reuses site .panel/.panel-grid/.data-table/.viz-root and monospace <pre> per plan (no new chrome), single deliberate accent (--seq-dark left-border on the canonical panel, which is color-scheme aware), sentence-case H2s, direct dialect-id + injector-param labels on every panel, no decorative ink beyond the existing flat panel border. Site is light-mode-first sitewide (pre-existing, not a DB-12 regression).

Three disclosed deviations judged sound: (1) omitted_ids reconciles the plan's 3-panel Tufte cap with AC1 by naming pattern.rust/scheme in the note and counting them in accounting rather than silently dropping -- correct call; (2) canonical spacing=True seed demo avoids the fake-variation the plan itself forbids and discloses it in-caption; (3) the noisy_parens purity bug is a genuine catch with a regression guard. All three improve fidelity to the plan's own principles. No implementation- or plan-level rework needed.
